Their actual inventory, sizes, licenses, and contents could not be inspected, so file count and content flags remain null. Separately, the p. 19 Data availability statement explicitly says the study datasets are not public and are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

notes:
Availability checked 2026-10-09. Read the complete 120814-character markdown conversion, including references and the final Publisher's Note, covering all 22 PDF pages. No appendix is appended, and PyMuPDF confirmed there are no embedded files. Checked PDF text on pp. 9, 13 and 19 to resolve scrambled supplementary-file references, and extracted other quoted statements directly from their PDF pages. Quotations preserve wording, with line wraps, soft hyphens, zero-width URL characters and extraction-induced spacing normalized. No preregistration, public study-code release, or study repository URL is named. The form's data_and_code contains no URLs: it repeats the request-only availability statement and leaves code_url empty. The acknowledgement contains no additional availability link.

All network checks used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without an email address or personal identifier. Title and first-author searches were attempted at all four required APIs; additional DOI and broader topic searches are recorded. Initial Zenodo searches with size=100 returned HTTP 400; retries without that parameter returned HTTP 200 and zero exact-title/author matches. Unrelated search hits are not counted as deposits. OSF title filtering is not a comprehensive contributor search.

Other paper-resource link checks: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/ returned HTTP 200 and redirected to HTTPS; https://epistemicnetwork.org timed out during the TLS handshake (no HTTP status), while http://epistemicnetwork.org returned HTTP 200 and redirected to https://www.epistemicnetwork.org/. The latter is the generic ENA software site, not this study's data/project export. The PDF's Crossmark status link http://crossmark.crossref.org/dialog/?doi=10.1186/s40594-026-00631-0&domain=pdf&date_stamp=2026-6-28 returned HTTP 200. Unrelated reference-list article DOIs were not treated as study data links, and no author was contacted.

No public participant-level or output-level study dataset was confirmed, downloaded, or inspected, so no rows or columns can be reported. Table 4 (p. 11) provides only representative coded question examples; Table 5 (p. 13) already reports arm-level post-test means, SDs and analyzed counts of 45 and 44. These printed examples and summaries do not provide the participant records needed to reconstruct scores, verify per-topic counts, or compute text/idea diversity. None of final.open_items is resolved by public data: the supplement contents, ENA observation/stanza units and per-topic counts, scoring-rule ambiguities, test-access/timing rules and prospective outcome priority remain unconfirmed. The explicit p. 19 request-only statement supports status on_request; overall confidence is medium because the publisher supplements could not be inspected. The deposits list contains one unverified publisher supplementary-material pointer, not a verified open data deposit.
